episode_title: Home Depot's SRS Expansion Spree, Winsupply's Run to $10B, and Distribution's Frontline Workforce Gap

real_qa.q: How many new SRS branches is Home Depot planning to launch in 2026?
real_qa.r: Home Depot is planning on launching as many as 40 to 50 new SRS branches next year as part of their multifaceted plan for expansion into various industries and verticals, including plumbing and HVAC.

real_qa.q: What is Winsupply's revenue target and timeline for achieving $10 billion in sales?
real_qa.r: Winsupply stated in a September 16th post that they are on track to achieve $10 billion in sales within approximately 24 months. They are currently in the neighborhood of $8.6 billion going to $9 billion this year.

real_qa.q: What distribution center expansion is Winsupply adding at their Ohio hub?
real_qa.r: Winsupply is adding quite a bit of distribution center space, specifically 254,000 square feet at their core hub in Ohio, while simultaneously expanding their local branch network.

real_qa.q: What is the latest wholesale trade inventory level reported by the U.S. Census Bureau?
real_qa.r: The Census Bureau reported wholesale trade inventories at $9.657 billion, up 1% from the previous month in July and 6% to 7% higher year-over-year. This marks the seventh consecutive month of wholesale inventory gains.

real_qa.q: How do wholesale sales growth rates compare to wholesale inventory growth rates?
real_qa.r: Wholesale sales on a non-inflation adjusted basis grew 13% year-over-year, more than double the inventory growth of 5.7%. When adjusted for inflation, inventory grew approximately 3% while sales grew around 10%, indicating distributors are growing more efficient and the sector is performing well.
real_qa.requete: wholesale sales vs inventory growth rate

real_qa.q: What is Winsupply's unique business model and how does it drive employee engagement?
real_qa.r: Winsupply operates on an entrepreneur-driven, locally-focused model where they share equity and foster profit sharing in every location they operate. This local ownership structure ensures that employees have long-term financial stakes in the success of their locations, creating fanatical followership and buy-in from their people.

real_quote: Capitalism doesn't just work at the top of the organization. It works across the organization at all levels.
